title: The Rust Moths
text: A cloud of moths with wings the color of rust settles over the party. Where they land, iron turns orange.

options.label: Run before they eat the gear.

outcomes.text: Most of the gear makes it. Some of the armor does not.

options.label: The most armored draws them off.

outcomes.text: They feast on that armor until it falls apart, and the rest of you go free.

options.label: The cleverest smokes them out with a fire.

outcomes.text: Sleepy moths, and their dust is worth something.
